subject: english
question:
Select the incorrectly spelt word from the given sentence.

And with modern technology. it would be possible to distribute lesure justly without injury to civilization.
solution:
The incorrect spelling is: **'Lesure'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lesure"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"leisure"**. (फुर्सत / अवकाश)
 
• **"Leisure"** refers to free time when one is not working or occupied; it is time for relaxation or activities of one's choice. (फुर्सत / अवकाश)
 
 
• **Example: **During the weekend, I finally have some leisure to enjoy my hobbies.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. 'Lesure'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Distribute** (वितरित करना): To give shares of something; to spread out.

 
 
• **Example:** The organization aims to distribute food and clothing to the needy.
 
 
 
• **Possible** (संभव): Able to be done or achieved.
 
 
• **Example: **With hard work, it is possible to achieve your dreams.
 
 
 
• **Technology** (प्रौद्योगिकी): The application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes.
 
 
• **Example:** Advances in technology have revolutionized the way we communicate.
 
 

3a:Ta02,

The incorrect spelling is: **choise**.
